title: IncrementALL
description: An ever-expanding incremental game — click with combo streaks, buy generators (10 tiers), unlock upgrades (28 total), auto-clickers, ascend (100× max) for multipliers, transcend for global multipliers, complete 7 challenges for permanent bonuses, and buy permanent perks that persist forever. Beyond 1Qa points: new milestones, 42 achievements, and infinite growth.
controls: Click the circle to earn points (combo builds) | Buy qty: ×1/×10/×100/MAX | 4 main tabs: Gen/Upg/Perks/Burst, top-right: 🏁Chal/📊Stats | Keys: 1-4 tabs, 5 chal, 6 stats, Space click, B ascend, T transcend, A auto-buy, E export, R reset | Auto-clickers trigger automatically | Ascend for multipliers up to 100× | Transcend after max ascension | 7 challenges unlocked at 10 ascensions
_goal: Reach 1,000,000,000,000,000 (1Qa) total points. Continue infinitely beyond with transcendence and challenges.

_resources.name: Points
_resources.description: Main currency. Earned by clicking and from generators. Carries across ascensions partially (base resets).

_resources.name: Total Points
_resources.description: Lifetime points earned (never resets). Used for ascension gain calculation and victory condition.

_transcendence.description: Second prestige layer unlocked after 100 ascensions. Resets everything (including ascensions) for +100% global multiplier per level.

_challenges.name: Clickomania
_challenges.desc: Only clicks earn points (no generator income)

_challenges.name: Ascension Rush
_challenges.desc: Must ascend within 60 seconds or lose

_achievements.categories: clicks, combos, generators, upgrades, ascensions, perks, transcendence, total points

_architecture.renderLoop: requestAnimationFrame with delta-time calculation. Tick rate capped at 50ms minimum delta.
_architecture.stateSchema: JSON in localStorage key 'incrementall_save'. Versioned (v2) with backward compat.
_architecture.offlineProgress: On load, if >5s elapsed since last save, PPS × elapsed is awarded as offline points.
_architecture.victory: Modal overlay when totalPoints >= 1,000,000. Option to continue playing.
_architecture.keyboardShortcuts: 1-6 tabs, Space click, B ascend, T transcend, A auto-buy, E export, R reset
_architecture.numberFormat: Suffixes: K, M, B, T, Qa, Qi, Sx, Sp, Oc (up to 1e27+)
